entries.zh: 头；开端、起始（头即一事之首）
entries.en: head; beginning, start (the head of a thing)

entries.zh: 序；次序之始、起首（亦指序文）
entries.en: order; the beginning of a sequence (also a preface)
beginning, commencement; start
to initiate, to be the first to advocate; to take the lead
entries.notes: M 栏多字[疑]读且尾段[残]，R 栏作“principio de exemplo”疑为编者注记而非官话对音，语义难定。

entries.zh: 创立，创建；创始（M 另出“建立”一读）
entries.en: to found, establish, create; to originate

entries.zh: 杂，杂糅；〔与“事物之始”义不相合，原委待考〕
entries.en: mixed, sundry (sense for 'principio de las cosas' unclear)
entries.notes: H 作“雜”、M 作 vo，与 L“principio de las cosas”三者不能互证，疑栏位错置或字形有讹。

entries.zh: 巅，山顶；顶端（引申为极点）
entries.en: summit, mountain top; apex, top
entries.notes: H“巔”与 M“fien”互证清楚，但与 L“principio de las cosas”义隔，取“顶端”引申义。

entries.zh: 肾；中医谓藏精、主生殖之脏（胎中精源）
entries.en: kidney; (Chinese med.) the organ holding seminal essence
entries.notes: R 栏为编者按语“examina mas el vocablo”，非官话对音；M 次字 ve 无对应汉字可定。

entries.zh: 汉，汉人；〔以之对译“世界之始”，义不相涉〕
entries.en: Han (Chinese); the Han people (glossed for 'principio del mundo')
entries.notes: L 为“世界之始”而 H 作“漢”，M“han”仅证字形读音，语义无法定夺。

entries.en: root, basis; the origin of things
beginning, first; at the beginning
origin, source, fount; principle
to establish, found; to lay the foundation
to begin, start; a beginning

entries.zh: 做起头，动手开始（H 作“佐”，当为“做”）
entries.en: to make a start, set about doing something
entries.notes: H 作“佐起頭”、M 作 cho，cho 通常对应“做”，字形与音写略有参差。

entries.en: at first, in the beginning; outset

entries.zh: 兴工，动工；开工（工程之始）
entries.en: to start work, begin construction; commencement of works
entries.notes: L 栏尾[残]，H“興工”与 M“hin cang”互证清楚，释义据汉字定。

entries.zh: 根源，本源；事物之根与本
entries.en: root and source, origin
root, foundation; the fundamental
root cause, underlying cause
original source, fountainhead
at first, in the beginning
entries.notes: M 栏“chuy quy chey. chuy tau.”两读重复且有讹写，义据 H“起初”定。
